input.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled because the CI job starts with a cold cargo registry cache (~18 min penalty) against a strict 30-minute job timeout, leaving little margin before normal variance pushes it over; fix is to cache ~/.cargo/registry (and target/) in the release pipeline (e.g. actions/cache keyed on Cargo.lock) rather than raising the timeout.
